observations: Photo 0 shows a large TV screen displaying a bright orange slice with text overlay: 'Neo QLED', '75QN94A', 'Quantum Matrix Technology', 'Quantum HDR 24X', 'Object Tracking Sound (OTS)', and 'SAMSUNG' logo in top right.
Photo 1 shows the same TV screen with a cocktail image and same text overlay on the left side.
Photo 2 shows the same TV screen with a bottle pouring liquid, same text overlay on the left side.
All three photos show the same TV from a frontal view, mounted on a wall with blue and white painted sections.
The screen is turned on and displaying vibrant, high-contrast images with clear text overlays.
The model number '75QN94A' is clearly visible in red text on the left side of the screen in all three photos.
The brand 'SAMSUNG' is visible in the top right corner of the screen in all three photos.
No physical body of the TV (bezel, stand, ports, back) is visible in any photo.
Reflections in the screen show a room with ceiling lights and a glass door or window.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI E-KENNETH' is overlaid on all images.

claims.claim: Samsung 75” Neo QLED QN90A 4K Smart TV
claims.evidence: The model number displayed on the screen in all photos is '75QN94A', not 'QN90A'.
The screen displays 'Neo QLED' and '75QN94A', which is a 75-inch model. The resolution is not directly visible, but the display quality suggests 4K UHD.
The text 'Quantum Matrix Technology' is visible on the screen in all three photos.

risks.risk: The TV may be non-functional or have display issues not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the TV turning on, changing channels, and displaying different content (including dark scenes and text) from multiple angles.

risks.risk: The TV may be damaged or have dead pixels not visible in the current display.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the screen showing a solid white, black, and red/green/blue screen to check for dead or stuck pixels.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential dead pixels

risks.risk: The TV may be a refurbished or used unit with hidden wear or missing accessories.
risks.proof: Photos of the TV's back, stand, ports, and included accessories (remote, cables, manuals).
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing accessories or with unknown condition

risks.risk: The TV may not be the genuine model advertised (e.g., a different model or counterfeit).
risks.proof: A photo of the TV's serial number or model label on the back or side of the unit.

proof_requests: Photos of the back of the TV showing the model and serial number label.
Photos of the TV's stand, ports, and included accessories.
A video showing the TV turning on, changing channels, and displaying different content.
Close-up photos of the screen showing solid white, black, and RGB screens to check for dead pixels.
response.reason: The model number shown on the screen is '75QN94A', contradicting the seller's claim of 'QN90A'. While the brand and model are identifiable, critical physical details (back, ports, accessories) and functional proof are missing. The TV's condition and authenticity cannot be confirmed without further evidence.
